title: Walk the campus gardens
description: Explore the paths, ponds and seasonal flowers together in the Thomas E. Ricks Gardens. Visit when the paths are clear of snow.
address: 505 S Center St, Rexburg, ID 83460

title: Explore the jungle greenhouse
description: Take a quiet walk among tropical plants in the Benson Building's jungle greenhouse. Enjoy the greenery and koi pond during public building hours; visiting is free.
address: 505 S Center St, Ezra Taft Benson Building, Rexburg, ID 83460

title: Explore the Spori Art Gallery
description: Browse the free rotating art exhibit and each choose a favorite work to discuss. Check gallery hours before visiting.
address: 48 E 2nd S, Jacob Spori Building Room 140, Rexburg, ID 83460

title: Write a tiny story at the library
description: Bring a notebook to the library, choose a writing prompt for each other and write a short story. Share your stories quietly in a conversation-friendly area.
address: 525 S Center St, David O. McKay Library, Rexburg, ID 83460

title: Bowl a game at Strike Zone
description: Challenge each other to an evening game at the campus bowling alley. The per-person budget covers one game and shoe rental; campus dress standards apply.
address: 101 E Viking Dr, Hyrum Manwaring Center Room 173, Rexburg, ID 83460

title: Tackle the campus ropes course
description: Encourage each other through elevated obstacles at the outdoor ropes course. Reserve a session and check seasonal hours, harness requirements and current rates; budget about $15 per person.
address: 50 W 7th S, Rexburg, ID 83440

title: Try different lunches at The Crossroads
description: Pick lunches from different campus food stations and compare your favorites over a relaxed conversation. Budget about $12 per person for a meal and check dining hours.
address: 101 E Viking Dr, Hyrum Manwaring Center, Rexburg, ID 83460

title: See a planetarium show
description: Watch a public astronomy show under the planetarium dome. Check the Thursday show schedule and arrive early for first-come tickets; admission is $2 per person.
address: 10 E 2nd S, George S. Romney Building Room 107, Rexburg, ID 83460

title: Watch a campus play
description: Book tickets to a student theatre production in the Snow Drama Theatre. Choose a scheduled performance at this venue; budget about $8 per person and check the event dress requirements.
address: 525 S Center St, Eliza R. Snow Performing Arts Center, Rexburg, ID 83460

title: Discover wildlife at the Benson museum
description: Explore preserved wildlife specimens from North America and Africa and compare your favorite adaptations. These are museum displays rather than live animals; visit during public building hours.
address: 505 S Center St, Ezra Taft Benson Building Room 218, Rexburg, ID 83460

title: Pick books for each other
description: Browse the public library and find a book you think the other person would enjoy. Read a few pages together; browsing is free and borrowing requires a library card.
address: 73 N Center St, Rexburg, ID 83440

title: Explore Rexburg's flood history
description: Visit the Museum of Rexburg's exhibits about local history and the Teton Dam flood. The museum has moved to City Hall; check its opening hours before going.
address: 35 N 1st E, Rexburg, ID 83440

title: Play tennis at Porter Park
description: Bring your own rackets and balls for a friendly match on the public tennis courts. Court use is free; choose a dry day and take turns if others are waiting.
address: S 2nd W and W 2nd S, Rexburg, ID 83440

title: Ride the historic carousel
description: Take a ride on the antique wooden carousel, then stroll around Porter Park. Admission is $2 per rider; the carousel operates seasonally, so check its schedule.
address: W 2nd S and S 3rd W, Porter Park, Rexburg, ID 83440

title: Warm up with cocoa at June's Place
description: Order hot chocolate and settle in for a relaxed conversation at the Main Street cafe. Budget about $6 per person for a drink; snacks cost extra.
address: 36 E Main St, Rexburg, ID 83440

title: Share wood-fired pizza
description: Choose a pizza together at Righteous Slice and compare favorite toppings. Budget about $18 per person for a shared pizza and a drink; the total depends on your order.
address: 175 W 2nd S, Suite 100, Rexburg, ID 83440

title: Take a photo walk at Hemming Village
description: Bring your phones and challenge each other to photograph interesting architecture, colors and storefront details from the public walkways. Compare your favorite shots afterward; no purchases are required.
address: 160 W 2nd S, Rexburg, ID 83440

title: Paint pottery and sip custom sodas
description: Choose ceramic pieces at Fire & Fizz and paint designs for each other. Budget about $35 per person for a medium piece, the $9 studio fee and a soda; return later to collect the fired pottery.
address: 14 W 1st S, Rexburg, ID 83440

title: Solve an escape room together
description: Work as a team to find clues and solve puzzles at Rexburg Re-Escape. Reserve a room suitable for two players and confirm the group minimum; budget about $30 per person.
address: 155 W Main St, Suite 7, Rexburg, ID 83440

title: Plan a steak dinner downtown
description: Sit down for steak at Red Rabbit Grill and share an appetizer or dessert. Budget about $35 per person for the meal; your final cost depends on the dishes you choose.
address: 155 W Main St, Suite 8, Rexburg, ID 83440

title: Visit the Idaho Falls Zoo
description: Walk the zoo paths together and discover your favorite animals. Adult admission is $12.50 before tax; the zoo operates seasonally, so confirm its opening dates.
place_name: Idaho Falls Zoo at Tautphaus Park
address: 2940 Carnival Way, Idaho Falls, ID 83402

title: Explore the East Idaho Aquarium
description: Explore aquatic exhibits together and learn about the animals on display. Budget about $20 per person for general admission and verify current tickets; optional feeding experiences cost extra.
address: 570 E Anderson St, Idaho Falls, ID 83401

title: Meet barnyard animals at Bear World
description: Explore Yellowstone Bear World's walk-through petting zoo together. It is included with park admission, not a separate low-cost ticket; budget about $50 per person and check seasonal dates and current rates.
address: 6010 S Bear World Rd, Rexburg, ID 83440

title: Explore history and science exhibits
description: Visit the Museum of Idaho and compare favorite discoveries in its permanent and changing exhibits. Budget $20 per adult for general admission; Idaho residents and students may qualify for discounts.
address: 200 N Eastern Ave, Idaho Falls, ID 83402

title: Find inspiration at the art museum
description: Browse changing exhibits at The Art Museum of Eastern Idaho and each choose a piece that inspires a future creative project. Regular adult admission is $8; check exhibit dates and opening hours.
place_name: The Art Museum of Eastern Idaho
address: 300 S Capital Ave, Idaho Falls, ID 83402

title: Stroll the Idaho Falls River Walk
description: Start along Memorial Drive and follow the public river paths to see the falls and riverside scenery. Walking is free; choose a comfortable route and dress for the weather.
address: Memorial Dr and W Broadway St, Idaho Falls, ID 83402

title: Watch riverside birds at Freeman Park
description: Walk the river edge and look for waterfowl and other birds together. Bring your own binoculars if you have them, keep your distance from wildlife and leave the birds' food to nature; park access is free.
address: 1290 Science Center Dr, Idaho Falls, ID 83402

title: Celebrate with dinner at Copper Rill
description: Reserve a table for a special dinner near the river. Budget about $45 per person for an entree and dessert; confirm menu prices and reservation availability.
address: 415 River Pkwy, Idaho Falls, ID 83402

title: Enjoy a riverside dinner at Sandpiper
description: Choose a seafood or steak dinner at Sandpiper and enjoy time together near the Snake River. Budget about $45 per person; outdoor seating depends on the season and availability.
address: 750 Lindsay Blvd, Idaho Falls, ID 83402

title: Try Rock & Bowl in Idaho Falls
description: Bowl together during a Friday or Saturday Rock & Bowl session. The published hourly rate is $15 per person including shoes; call ahead to reserve a lane and confirm the session time.
address: 670 1st St, Idaho Falls, ID 83401
